issues.title: Ingest the Denver budget
issues.learned: Denver 2026 all-funds budget $4.44B (net of $447M interfund transfers), General Fund $1.68B. Denver International Airport ($789M ops) is the biggest enterprise. One consolidated city-county since 1902. Foots to the dollar.

issues.title: General Fund by agency
issues.detail: The $1.68B General Fund is one line; add the 15-agency breakdown (Safety, DOTI, Parks) once exact per-agency dollars are pulled.
